**Endpoint:** `GET /api/log/:sessionId?page=0&limit=20` (`worker/src/routes/log.ts`, `logRoutes`). Query on `adventure_log` sorted `created_at DESC` for paging, then each page is reversed so entries return oldest-first within that page; page 0 = newest, higher pages = further back. `limit` clamped 1–50 (default 20); `page` clamped to ≥0. Response: `{ entries, total, page, limit }`.

**UI:** `GameConsoleComponent.loadMoreLog()` (game-console.component.ts, ~line 199) guards on `logLoading()`/`logExhausted()`, increments `logPage`, calls `api.getLog(sessionId, logPage, 20)`, prepends `res.entries` to `logEntries`. It marks exhaustion with `if (this.logPage * 20 >= res.total) this.logExhausted.set(true)` — i.e., once the cumulative fetched count reaches the server-reported `total`, "Load more" stops firing further requests.
